race.comment: COUGARS (6) was off a short break first-up on the Acton where he was just fair, holding his own down to the line. The blinkers go on for the first time now, Boudvillain replaces the apprentice and he maps to get every chance out to 1200m. He ticks plenty of boxes and looks poised to bounce back to winning ways. HURRY MISS (8) looks beautifully placed coming back to this level after racing in Saturday and Highway grade since her return. The blinkers come off, the nose roll is reapplied and she only carries 55.5kg. Ticks plenty of boxes in this much easier assignment. ALOTTOSAY (5) finished off nicely first-up as a $61 chance at Warwick Farm and looks poised to strike here second-up. She improved through the grades nicely last time in work and Day knows her well. Leading chance. BELLEISTIC KIDS (2) is not to be discounted here first-up being a track and trip winner.
